posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
This isn't official, but I think the IL storyline is the original time line.  The base game refers to the original time line being the death of Legacy, but Visionary was already in that timeline, so it wasn't the original, it was already being alterred.

Plus the only alternate approximately present day things were Iron Legacy, The Dreamer and Dark Visionary.  I think the Timelines crashing may have been much more localized to specific events, notably the events surrounding Visionary returning and changing the time line.

Like as time edged closer to the point where the original death of Pauline would change to the death of Paul the two paths were set at odds with each other and the rules that govern the multiverse, seperate realities and time started colliding.  I think The Dreamer was the biggest part of the time cataclysm, it is possible someone was messing with her powers because visionary showed she could travel through time.  Someone with a nefarious use for such powers.

posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
THE Freedom 6 was exclusively created to confront Iron Legacy. Sentinel Tactics takes place after all of the timelines merge into one, so there are some shenanigans involved there.

Visionary was from the IL timeline, and went back to try and stop it. She tampered with her own creation, so OUR Vanessa Long is the Dreamer, rather than the Visionary. Then, because IL intruded upon our timeline, and our Legacy and Young Legacy were tired/injured in the fight, they didn't get around to confronting Baron Blade, so neither of them died, leading to their coexistence in Tactics.
